goal: Build and maintain websites, books, code, research, education, brand publishing and the ONE Federation under owner-controlled source-preserving change monitoring.

rules.original_words: Byte-for-byte originals never rewritten by a team; editorial drafts and code changes live in separate proposed outputs.
rules.no_fabricated_completion: A proposal is never marked as implemented, published, tested or deployed until the corresponding validation actually passes.
rules.permissions: Read-only project inspection and local generated artifacts. No unauthorized external system access, account actions, private uploads, secret collection or automatic merges.
rules.monitored_changes: Observe any tracked git change in the compared revision and compare the specifically locked creator originals against recorded Git object IDs.
rules.restoration: Generate exact restoration patches for locked sources and open an owner-review issue; never silently revert owner-approved changes on main.
rules.workers: Use existing 763 catalog identities as source-defined role labels; execute a bounded number of real team processes, not billions of model calls.

teams.function: Index exact author manuscript headings; produce separate editorial maps and working editions

teams.name: ONE Database & Provenance

teams.name: Research, Language & Evidence
teams.function: Track source leads, etymologies and claims separately from verified evidence

teams.name: Courses & Teaching
teams.function: Plan instruction and workbook material from source-grounded methods without inventing teachings

teams.name: Marketing, Publishing & Outreach
teams.function: Prepare linked publishing and website inventories, copy plans and source-backed launch checklists

teams.name: Quality, Release & Test
teams.function: Check executable output, missing tests, release readiness and CI contract

teams.name: Change Watch & Restoration
teams.function: Track any repo change; verify locked creator originals; prepare reversible repair proposals
